title: A Colony for the Machine
author: Lior Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Oyelaran, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
